_comment: Schema source for the Firestore services/{id} catalog. Public info only, no secrets. Seeded from the Permissions tab (owner, 'Seed catalog'). See docs/permissions.md.

files.name: Team files (browser)
files.description: TeraStation WebAccess. Also needs your own TeraStation account. Does not cover network drives.

files-smb.name: Team files (network drives)
files-smb.description: SMB drives through the Cloudflare One Client. Needs an enrolled device and a TeraStation account.

ha.name: Home Assistant
ha.description: Smart-home dashboard. Also needs a Home Assistant account (the owner creates it).

sheila-ssh.name: SHEILA SSH
sheila-ssh.description: Tunnel access only; you also need an authorized SSH key.

laptop-ssh.name: Laptop SSH
laptop-ssh.description: Tunnel access only; you also need an authorized SSH key.

rdp.name: Remote Desktop (SHEILA, laptop)
rdp.description: RDP over the Cloudflare One Client (Gateway policy). Windows login still required.

agentdash.name: AgentController dashboard
agentdash.description: view = read-only, operate = start/stop agents, admin = everything.

pmjc.name: pmjc switchboard
pmjc.description: Personal MCP job controller (can run commands and send messages as the owner). Own Google login, owner only.

passwords.name: Passwords (Vaultwarden)
passwords.description: Password manager. Own account (the owner invites you); Google sign-in for @fwogg3r.com; no Access app so the Bitwarden apps work.

photos.name: Photos (Immich)
photos.description: Photo library (Immich). Use 'Login with Cloudflare'; your account is created on first sign-in. Shared albums are by invitation. The iPhone app works too.

lmstudio.name: Local LLMs (LM Studio)
lmstudio.description: LM Studio API through the Cloudflare One Client. No API key.
